title: Sheepdog Simulator set in the Yorkshire Dales
author: invertedworld
selftext:
[https://invertedworld.itch.io/sheepdog-simulator](https://invertedworld.itch.io/sheepdog-simulator)  
  
Made with Fable and Claude Code.  
  
Very pleased with the sheep flocking and the grass simulation.   
  
To be honest the game is not as much fun as being a dog running around in the beautiful hills. Enjoy!

To

comments.author: re-skob
comments.body: the controls are nonsensical. Does this dog have tank controls or something?

replies.author: invertedworld
replies.body: what is the issue? WASD is pretty standard

replies.author: re-skob
replies.body: you're not using standard WASD controls which are camera relative - W goes forward into the camera, A, S strafe to the left and right of the camera, S goes back from the camera. You're using tank controls which rotate the character left and right with A and D, and S doesn't even move backwards, it just flips the dog backwards. It makes the dog feel like a tank (that can't reverse)

replies.author: invertedworld
replies.body: Please try again, I have made some changes to controls. You can press K to adjust settings.

comments.author: Due_Departure5285
comments.body: I'm a yankee, i don't consider myself an Anglophile... but i do consider myself a Yorkshirephile.  following you on itch now

comments.author: Robonotes1760
comments.body: Interesting and unusual concept! The controls are hard to use - we seem to steer way too far and also can't turn when stationary, which is not very dog. Also - we play as a dog and we can't woof? Opportunity missed!

replies.author: invertedworld
replies.body: Will tune the steering, thanks for the feedback. B = Bark

replies.author: Robonotes1760
replies.body: Aha, thank you! You should perhaps show that control on screen at the beginning.

replies.author: invertedworld
replies.body: Please try again, I have made some changes to controls. You can press K to adjust settings.

replies.author: Robonotes1760
replies.body: Definitely better - but the convention with mouselook is that the sideways keys strafe (i.e. sidestep without changing view direction) rather than turn.

comments.author: Due_Departure5285
comments.body:
i gotta say, the controls are a little loosey and squirrely... but i really enjoyed my time with it. 

i think if you keep fleshing it out it's a really cool game.  

can I suggest: both mouse buttons held down to go forward?  e.g. World of Warcraft.  just a thought...
